name: out-and-back on the same street, heading decides

steps.why: At x = 500 m the fix is 2 m from the outbound lane and 6 m from the return lane; westward heading selects the return lane at 1000 + 8 + (1000 − 500) = 1508 m.
The point projects 4 m from each pass, at route advances 200 m and 1808 m. From 1508 m, the next pass is 1808 − 1508 = 300 m away; add the 4 m offset: 300 + 4 = 304 m.
